root_cause.text: The device reference (via __dev_put()) was released inside linkwatch_do_dev() before the caller’s subsequent netdev_unlock_ops() access, allowing netdev_run_todo() to concurrently free the device and leading to a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "After linkwatch_do_dev() calls __dev_put() to release the linkwatch reference, the device refcount may drop to 1. At this point, netdev_run_todo() can proceed … and then free the device … This creates a use-after-free when __linkwatch_run_queue() tries to call netdev_unlock_ops() on the already-freed device." The patch moves __dev_put() from linkwatch_do_dev() to its callers, placing it after netdev_unlock_ops() to ensure the device remains valid during all accesses.
